plan_summary: Inspect the required API docs without printing them, authenticate through Supervisor-provided credentials, paginate a title search, inspect the exact Bucket List note, derive the checkbox-only content change, update it, verify the persisted note, and complete the task.

steps.reasoning: The required public API contracts must be inspected before any task API is called. Each result is stored separately and not printed, avoiding serialization issues from documentation internals.
steps.action_code:
doc_show_profile = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="supervisor", api_name="show_profile")
doc_show_passwords = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="supervisor", api_name="show_account_passwords")
doc_login = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="login")
doc_search_notes = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="search_notes")
doc_show_note = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="show_note")
doc_update_note = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="simple_note", api_name="update_note")
doc_complete_task = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name="supervisor", api_name="complete_task")
verification_targets: Public documentation is retained for every required task API before its first use.

steps.reasoning: The Simple Note username and password must come from Supervisor APIs and remain in variables. The account name is matched by normalization rather than relying on a credential value.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_password_records = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
simple_note_accounts = [record for record in account_password_records if "".join(ch for ch in record["account_name"].casefold() if ch.isalnum()) == "simplenote"]
if len(simple_note_accounts) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one Simple Note account credential")
simple_note_password = simple_note_accounts[0]["password"]
simple_note_login = apis.simple_note.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=simple_note_password)
simple_note_access_token = simple_note_login["access_token"]
print({"simple_note_account_matches": len(simple_note_accounts), "authenticated": bool(simple_note_access_token)})
verification_targets: Exactly one normalized Simple Note account is selected.
A nonempty Simple Note access token is retained without exposing credentials.

steps.reasoning: The instruction identifies the note as Bucket List. All pages of the matching note search must be read before selecting a note.
steps.action_code:
search_pages = []
all_note_summaries = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    search_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query="Bucket List", page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    search_pages.append(search_page)
    all_note_summaries.extend(search_page)
    if len(search_page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
bucket_list_summaries = [note for note in all_note_summaries if note["title"].strip().casefold() == "bucket list"]
print({"pages_read": len(search_pages), "exact_title_candidates": bucket_list_summaries})
verification_targets: Every search page is collected through the first short page.
Exact-title Bucket List candidates are derived from returned public records.

steps.reasoning: The complete search results are available, so the unique exact-title note can be selected and its content retrieved before deciding how to edit it.
steps.action_code:
if len(bucket_list_summaries) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one note titled Bucket List")
selected_note_summary = bucket_list_summaries[0]
bucket_list_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=selected_note_summary["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token)
print(bucket_list_note)
verification_targets: Exactly one exact-title note is selected.
The selected note's current public content and metadata are retrieved.

steps.reasoning: The selected note content is available. Before any mutation, locate the instructed item exactly once and derive a minimal checkbox-marker change while preserving all other content.
steps.action_code:
target_item = "Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
original_content = bucket_list_note["content"]
content_lines = original_content.splitlines(keepends=True)
target_line_indexes = [index for index, line in enumerate(content_lines) if target_item in line]
if len(target_line_indexes) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected the target item exactly once in Bucket List")
target_line_index = target_line_indexes[0]
target_line = content_lines[target_line_index]
target_position = target_line.find(target_item)
target_prefix = target_line[:target_position]
pending_markers = ("[ ]", "☐", "□", "⬜")
done_markers = ("[x]", "[X]", "☑", "☒", "✅")
pending_marker = next((marker for marker in pending_markers if marker in target_prefix), None)
already_done_marker = next((marker for marker in done_markers if marker in target_prefix), None)
if pending_marker is not None:
    replacement_marker = {"[ ]": "[x]", "☐": "☑", "□": "☑", "⬜": "✅"}[pending_marker]
    marker_position = target_prefix.rfind(pending_marker)
    updated_prefix = target_prefix[:marker_position] + replacement_marker + target_prefix[marker_position + len(pending_marker):]
    updated_lines = list(content_lines)
    updated_lines[target_line_index] = updated_prefix + target_line[target_position:]
    updated_content = "".join(updated_lines)
    needs_update = True
elif already_done_marker is not None:
    updated_content = original_content
    needs_update = False
else:
    raise RuntimeError("The target item has no recognized checklist marker")
print({"selected_note_id": bucket_list_note["note_id"], "target_occurrences": len(target_line_indexes), "needs_update": needs_update})
verification_targets: The target occurs on exactly one line.
The derived content changes only a recognized pending marker, or records that the item is already done.

steps.reasoning: The reviewed variables identify the selected note and exact desired content. Apply the content update only when the item is not already marked done.
steps.action_code:
update_response = None
if needs_update:
    update_response = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=bucket_list_note["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token, content=updated_content)
print({"mutation_performed": needs_update, "update_response": update_response})
verification_targets: The derived content is submitted to the selected Bucket List note when a change is required.

steps.reasoning: After the conditional update, the note must be fetched again so the persisted checkbox state and preservation of the intended content and metadata can be checked from public data.
steps.action_code:
verified_bucket_list_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=bucket_list_note["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token)
verified_content = verified_bucket_list_note["content"]
verified_lines = verified_content.splitlines(keepends=True)
verified_target_lines = [line for line in verified_lines if target_item in line]
verified_done = False
if len(verified_target_lines) == 1:
    verified_line = verified_target_lines[0]
    verified_position = verified_line.find(target_item)
    verified_prefix = verified_line[:verified_position]
    verified_done = any(marker in verified_prefix for marker in done_markers)
content_matches_derivation = verified_content == updated_content
metadata_preserved = (verified_bucket_list_note["note_id"] == bucket_list_note["note_id"] and verified_bucket_list_note["title"] == bucket_list_note["title"] and verified_bucket_list_note["tags"] == bucket_list_note["tags"] and verified_bucket_list_note["pinned"] == bucket_list_note["pinned"])
verification = {"target_occurrences": len(verified_target_lines), "target_marked_done": verified_done, "content_matches_derivation": content_matches_derivation, "metadata_preserved": metadata_preserved}
if not (len(verified_target_lines) == 1 and verified_done and content_matches_derivation and metadata_preserved):
    raise RuntimeError("Bucket List postcondition verification failed")
print(verification)
verification_targets: The persisted target appears exactly once and has a recognized done marker.
Persisted content equals the reviewed derived content.
The selected note identity, title, tags, and pinned status are preserved.
